interpretation: 417 indexed elements are NOT 417 unique finished buildings; many elements are variants, partial pieces, facades, or roofs. Raw PNG count includes 4 directions and material variants.

tile_geometry.Isometric Tiles Buildings: often 132/133px ground-footprint images and 99/100px stack sections; exact alpha anchoring varies
tile_geometry.Isometric Modular Buildings: 224 x 206 canvas; README says 180 x 115 tile footprint
tile_geometry.Isometric Vector Buildings: typically 50 px width; a distinct scale and component style

licensing: License.txt present for all three building packs; Kenney CC0
